d.d: The seventeenth numeral symbol of the English alphabet, called cue and written in the Latin script.

Abbreviation of non-automatic qualification, indicating an athlete who qualifies to the next round either by time as a fastest loser (in track events) or by position without achieving the qualifying target (in field events).
The first quarter of a calendar year (January, February and March).
The first quarter of a financial year.
The second quarter of a calendar year (April, May and June).
The second quarter of a financial year.
The third quarter of a calendar year (July, August and September)
The third quarter of a financial year.
The fourth and final quarter of a calendar year (October, November and December).
The fourth and final quarter of a financial year.
